# 11Players (Hagoozat Elite)
> The premier amateur football matchmaking, turf pitch management, and real-life player rating platform.

## Overview
11Players (Hagoozat Elite) transforms local football matches into a competitive, statistics-driven sports experience. Captains and community organizers create communities, schedule turf matches, balance teams using a proprietary Positional Suitability Index (PSI) algorithm, and track real-time player ratings, goals, assists, and awards.

## Core Capabilities
- **Proprietary Positional Suitability Index (PSI)**: Balances 5v5, 7v7, 8v8, and 11v11 matches objectively based on verified real-world physical and technical attributes.
- **Turf Pitch Split-Bill Calculator**: Automated expense allocation supporting EGP, SAR, USD, and EUR with real-time payment collection status tracking.
- **Verified Player Cards & XP Skill Trees**: Dynamic FIFA-style player cards featuring overall ratings (OVR), peer reviews, MVP badges, and disciplinary records.
- **Community Management & Real-Time Chat**: Dedicated community silos with chat slow-mode moderation, live match broadcasts, and automated season ceremonies.
- **Pro Pass Subscription Tiers**: Pro Captain and Club Organizer tiers offering priority scouting, advanced tactical AI assistance, and squad analytics.
